D: A dad struggles to let go as his daughter plans her wedding with an over-the-top planner.
P: Serve the hot dogs when George loses it over the buns.
S: George's supermarket meltdown over the hot dog buns
Hot dogs where the franks and the buns finally match, eight of each. Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes and tuck into 8 buns.
Smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche, a fancy bite for meeting the rich in-laws. Warm 16 blinis.
M: Roast chicken with potatoes and green beans, the reception dinner that cost a fortune. Roast a whole chicken at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes with 800g potatoes.
W: Vanilla butter cake with white icing. Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and 250g self-raising flour.
K: Cold milk in tall glasses. Chill 1L milk and pour into 4 tall glasses.

s.note: George's supermarket meltdown over the hot dog buns
s.how: Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes and tuck into 8 buns. Exactly 8. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Warm 16 blinis. Top with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and chives. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table. Put it out before the opening credits so everyone can graze.

m.how: Roast a whole chicken at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes with 800g potatoes. Steam 300g green beans and serve together. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and 250g self-raising flour. Bake at 175C for 40 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with butter and milk.

d.how: Chill 1L milk and pour into 4 tall glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
